not_evaluated.clause: Applicable engines are those manufactured new, rebuilt, overhauled, or fitted with a crankshaft after March 1, 1997 (manufacture/overhaul date clause)
not_evaluated.quote: These applicable engines are manufactured new or rebuilt, overhauled, or had a crankshaft installed after March 1, 1997.

not_evaluated.clause: No action if Lycoming manufactured, rebuilt, overhauled or repaired the engine, or replaced the crankshaft, before March 1, 1997 and the crankshaft has not been replaced since
not_evaluated.quote: If Lycoming Engines manufactured new, rebuilt, overhauled, or repaired your engine, or replaced the crankshaft in your engine before March 1, 1997, and you have not had the crankshaft replaced, no further action is required.

not_evaluated.clause: No action if the engine is in compliance with certain earlier Lycoming MSBs (552, 553, 566, Supplement 1 to 566, 569, 569A) and the crankshaft has not been replaced since (compliance history)
not_evaluated.quote: If your engine meets any of the following conditions, and you have not had the crankshaft replaced since meeting the condition, no further action is required:

parsed.compliance_time_text: Replace the affected crankshaft (one listed in Table 5 of MSB 569A) at the earliest of: the next engine overhaul per Lycoming SI 1009AS, the next separation of the crankcase, or no later than 12 years from when the crankshaft first entered service or was last overhauled, whichever is later.

effective_date: (a) This airworthiness directive (AD) becomes effective November 3, 2006.

unsafe_condition_summary: (d) This AD results from reports of 23 confirmed failures of similar crankshafts in Lycoming Engines 360 and 540 series reciprocating engines. We are issuing this AD to prevent failure of the crankshaft, which will result in total engine power loss, in-flight engine failure, and possible loss of the aircraft.
